## Procedure
**Double click** to edit me. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/components/sticky-notes/)
###
1. Edit fields Set the date and time, enter the javascript value
Prompt:give me the one liner java script expression to get the date and time i the below format:
DDMMYYYY: HH:MM:SS
2. Jave Script: {{ new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:T.Z]/g,'').replace(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2}).*$/, (_,y,mo,d,h,mi,s) => `${d}${mo}${y}:${h}${mi}${s}`) }}
3. Write a pyautogui script to open notepad and write the input arg(input from the user) in the notepad and save it. First time give file name as 'socialeagledemo.txt' and next time open the same file add new input in new line give ctlr+S. Save the file in the following location: D:\Abdul_AI\RPA_UI_N8Nauto

4. Convert the below script to Flask API: Input args should get it from the payload import pyautogui import time import os import subprocess import sys FILE_PATH = r"D:\Abdul_AI\RPA_UI_N8Nauto\socialeagledemo.txt" def open_notepad_with_file(file_path=None): if file_path: subprocess.Popen(["notepad.exe", file_path]) else: subprocess.Popen(["notepad.exe"]) time.sleep(1.5) # Allow Notepad to open def write_and_save_first_time(user_input): # Write the text pyautogui.typewrite(user_input, interval=0.05) # Save the file (Ctrl+S) pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's') time.sleep(1) # Type the full file path pyautogui.typewrite(FILE_PATH, interval=0.03) # Press Enter to save pyautogui.press('enter') time.sleep(1) def append_and_save(user_input): # Move cursor to end (Notepad usually starts at top) pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'end') pyautogui.press('enter') # Write new input pyautogui.typewrite(user_input, interval=0.05) # Save pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's') time.sleep(1) def main(): if len(sys.argv) < 2: print("Pass the text input as argument.") return user_input = sys.argv[1] file_exists = os.path.exists(FILE_PATH) if not file_exists: # First time open_notepad_with_file() write_and_save_first_time(user_input) else: # Subsequent time open_notepad_with_file(FILE_PATH) append_and_save(user_input) if __name__ == "__main__": main()

5. After API run : getting the URL :http://127.0.0.1:5000
